summary:
Hello, I am Arpita - a Data Analytics Leader and Content Creator.

With over 12 years of experience in data analysis, BI reporting, and database management, I currently serve as the Manager of BI, Database, and Data Administration, where I lead teams in delivering impactful, data-driven solutions. My work spans industries such as Finance, Banking, Telecommunications, Manufacturing, Oil & Gas, and Sales Operations, driving innovation through data insights and collaboration.

Beyond my professional role, I am passionate about giving back to the community. Through LinkedIn, I share job opportunities, career tips, and industry insights to help students and early professionals build their careers and navigate the job market with confidence.

Areas of Expertise:

🔹 BI & Analytics: Tableau, Power BI, QlikSense, Pentaho Kettle ETL
🔹 Databases: MS SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle, Access, Excel (Advanced Analytics)
🔹 Programming: Python, R, Java, HTML, JavaScript, SAS
🔹 Machine Learning: Regression Analysis, Decision Trees, Naïve Bayes, KNN
🔹 Soft Skills: Agile Development, Team Management, Stakeholder Communication, Resource Planning

🎓 I earned my degree from the Illinois Institute of Technology, Chicago, where I specialized in data management and IT consulting. This education has been foundational in my career, enabling me to tackle complex challenges with a combination of technical and strategic expertise.

💡 What I am Passionate About:
- Mentoring and guiding professionals.
- Sharing networking, job search tips, and resources for career growth.
- Continuously learning and evolving in the field of data analytics.

💬 Let’s Connect ! Whether you are interested in discussing data solutions, career development, or opportunities to collaborate, I am always open to meaningful conversations. For inquiries, feel free to reach out via email at arpita6050@gmail.com

items.title: ETL & Insights on COVID-19 Data
items.description:
Tools & Technologies  -Pentaho Kettle ETL, SQL, Tableau, Power BI

To represent the impact of COVID-19 all around the globe, I have extracted the data from various sources and transformed it using Pentaho Kettle. Later, I have designed dimensional modeling with star schema and used MySQL Server to store the normalized data. Finally, using Tableau I have provided insights on impacted countries, states, recovery rate, testing rate, gender, symptoms, and the age group infected the most with coronavirus.

items.title: Process Improvement in Healthcare
items.description: According to American Health Information Management Association, the amount of duplicate records in most hospitals is estimated to be between 5% to 10% of all the stored records. To resolve this issues we are proposing the use of bio-metric security to access the health care records. Biometric scanning device to be placed in ambulance and hospital that gives a quick access to the medical and personal records. This will provide hospitals/physicians a central location with all the health details of a person and can be used in emergency medical situation when a patient is unconscious. In this project we have shown the "AS-IS" and "TO-BE" representation along with the process flow, root cause analysis, limitations, and future scope.

items.title: Design and Implementation of Remote Monitoring System
items.description: In this paper, we have presented the issues faced by St. Jude healthcare services in remotely monitoring the pacemaker device. By using a BlueSync technology we have proposed a new design by which the pacemaker can be monitored remotely and eliminates the requirement of a transmitter located at patients’ homes. Also, we have shown how the release and deployment strategy comes into the picture in order to successfully release this new design. Finally, we have presented some of the major event management procedures which must be followed for the successful operation of this new device.
